categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of in vitro diagnostic reagents, focusing on allergy and autoimmune disease testing. It offers a broad product portfolio including IgE allergy detection, food-specific IgG detection, and autoimmune antibody detection reagents. Additionally, it is developing desensitization drugs and related diagnostic instruments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), enzyme-linked immunosorbent capture assay, and nano-magnetic particle chemiluminescence immunoassay. The company has proprietary antigen and antibody preparation technologies and emphasizes automated, quantitative detection platforms. Production follows strict quality management systems compliant with ISO13485 and medical device regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are hospitals at various levels, third-party clinical testing institutions, and healthcare providers in China. The company also serves international markets including Europe and the Middle East. Its products assist clinical diagnosis and treatment of allergic and autoimmune diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou and Changsha. The company is expanding international sales in Europe, the Middle East, South Asia, and Africa. It has established a nationwide sales and service network covering over 30 provinces in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on reagent and instrument manufacturing and sales. It also engages in upstream activities by producing core raw materials such as recombinant antigens and monoclonal antibodies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the product menu for allergy and autoimmune diagnostics, advancing nano-magnetic chemiluminescence technology, and developing desensitization drugs. R&D focuses on automation, quantitative detection, and import substitution. The company invests heavily in clinical trials, international registration, and new product development to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. The company uses a sales model dominated by distributors with supplementary direct sales to hospitals and testing labs. It also generates income from licensing and clinical research collaborations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international leaders like Thermo Fisher's Phadia, EUROIMMUN, and domestic peers such as Shenzhen Yahui Long. The company holds a leading position domestically in allergy IgE detection and is a pioneer in chemiluminescence-based autoimmune diagnostics, actively pursuing import substitution and international market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 402 million, a 2.01% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 36.8 million, down 22.24%. It maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~11.5% of revenue) and has steadily expanded production capacity and sales networks. The company is transitioning to profitability with ongoing investments in new business areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a comprehensive and rich product menu covering a wide range of allergens and autoimmune markers, with advanced quantitative and automated detection technologies. Its proprietary nano-magnetic chemiluminescence platform offers higher sensitivity, specificity, and throughput compared to traditional methods. The integration of diagnostic reagents with desensitization therapies provides a full-cycle solution for allergy management, differentiating it from competitors.
